invariants.rationale: flingTime represents a duration parameter and is likely expected to be non-negative.
The parameter velocityX is assigned directly to this.velocityX within the method, so they should be equal at exit.
The parameter velocityY is assigned directly to this.velocityY within the method, so they should be equal at exit.
The parameter flingTime is assigned directly to this.flingTimer within the method, so they should be equal at exit.
The absolute value of a velocity (float) is always non-negative.
